findings.evidence: The changed generic iterator uses the cached descriptor size at lv_draw_label.c:221, while src/draw/nema_gfx/lv_draw_nema_gfx_label.c:433-442 retains its private expanded-text lv_text_get_size call on the Nema label-task route.
findings.reason: Reduced from P2 to P3 because this leaves a pre-existing per-draw cost on one optional backend rather than introducing a functional regression; the surviving item was posted as a question.

findings.evidence: The Nema GFX private iterator still measures expanded text during drawing even though the changed generic iterator no longer does.
findings.reason: This is the same incomplete Nema GFX optimization as f1, independently phrased by the intent lens, so it was merged into f1.

findings.evidence: Several non-label producers set LV_TEXT_FLAG_EXPAND without filling text_size, but src/misc/lv_text.c:334-343 returns from lv_text_get_next_line without consulting max_width whenever EXPAND is set.
findings.reason: Although initially folded under f1 because it shared the changed run, validation showed that zero text_size.x cannot cause the alleged wrapping or cropping because expanded line iteration ignores the width argument.
